reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the sachet: one a day, tear it open with one hand, toss it in my bag. My vitamins sit on the counter and I forget them, so something I can carry fits my day, and the QR lab report is a nice extra. I'd start with the plain bisglycinate because it's easy to understand.
objection: Why only 3 forms when others have 8 or 14 in one capsule? And $30 a month for magnesium is more than I usually spend, so I'm not sure it's worth it over a cheaper bottle.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller starter pack or a lower first-box price, or a creator showing the QR report on screen so I can see it's real.
